source.title: Glossary
source.description: Terminology reference defining core concepts including the agentic loop, `CLAUDE.md`, compaction, hooks, skills, subagents versus agent teams, MCP, permission modes, sessions, and checkpoints, each linking to its in-depth page.

source.title: Configure permissions
source.description: How `allow`/`ask`/`deny` rules resolve deny-first, permission modes like `acceptEdits`/`plan`/`bypassPermissions`, per-tool specifiers (`Bash` globs, gitignore-anchored `Read`/`Edit`, `WebFetch(domain:)`), `PreToolUse` hooks, and managed-settings precedence.

source.title: Extend Claude with skills
source.description: `SKILL.md` frontmatter for authoring skills, invocation control (`disable-model-invocation`/`user-invocable`), location precedence across personal/project/plugin, `$ARGUMENTS` and `!command` injection, `context: fork` subagents, and evaluation with `skill-creator`.

source.title: Run Claude Code programmatically
source.description: Non-interactive `claude -p` for CI and scripts: `--bare` skips hooks/plugins/MCP auto-discovery, `--output-format json` with `--json-schema` structures results, `--allowedTools`/permission-modes auto-approve, stdin piping, and `--continue`/`--resume` for multi-turn sessions.

source.title: Create custom subagents
source.description: Defining specialized delegates in `.claude/agents/` with YAML frontmatter (`tools`, `model`, `permissionMode`, `skills`, `memory`, `hooks`); scope precedence, built-in Explore/Plan agents, automatic versus `@`-mention/`--agent` delegation, and `/fork` inheriting the conversation.
